code:
# PaaS: Azure SQL Database
azurerm_mssql_server + azurerm_mssql_database
# Microsoft manages the OS and SQL Server binaries

# IaaS: SQL Server on a VM
azurerm_windows_virtual_machine + SQL VM extension
# You own patching and OS-level configuration
